title: Low-tail red-cell hemoglobin concentration did not establish added grip-strength prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Low-tail MCHC curvature did not establish incremental combined-grip prediction beyond conventional CBC and body measures across NHANES2011–2012 and2013–2014 adults. Target weighted MSE gain 0.1236 kg² had400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval[-0.2071,0.4128];source cross-validation gain was negative. This is not equivalence or evidence of absent physiology.
